title: T1000-E: Internal flash storage
description: Validate internal flash partitions on T1000-E. UF2-style layout is modeled. Test NonVolatile operations via settings or NVS.
close_reason: Already validated: T1000-E internal flash is fully modeled in t1000_e_nrf52840.dts (storage_partition at 0xBF000, 16KB). NVS/Settings enabled in board config, used by epoch_persist.c for link-layer epoch persistence. Flash layout documented in FLASHING.md with hardware-tested errata. SMP OTA working confirms flash operations functional.
